name: Litti Chokha (Eastern UP)
instructions: 1. Prepare the Litti stuffing by mixing Sattu with finely chopped onions, ginger, garlic, green chilies, coriander, mustard oil, carom seeds, nigella seeds, and pickle masala. 2. Knead the wheat flour into a firm dough and shape into small cups. 3. Fill the cups with the Sattu mixture, seal them, and roll into balls. 4. Bake the balls in a traditional charcoal oven or modern oven until golden brown. 5. Roast the eggplant, potatoes, and tomatoes over an open flame until charred. 6. Peel the roasted vegetables, mash them together with chopped garlic, green chilies, onion, coriander, salt, and raw mustard oil to make the Chokha. 7. Serve hot Litti dipped in melted ghee alongside the Chokha.
description: Litti Chokha is a rustic, hearty staple of Eastern Uttar Pradesh and Bihar. Historically a survival food for travelers and soldiers due to its long shelf life, it has evolved into a beloved comfort food, often prepared during winter gatherings and social celebrations.
